jobs.description:
Company Description

Halluminate is an applied AI and data company working with frontier labs to train financial services and knowledge work superintelligence. We build high-quality computer-use and tool-use reinforcement learning (RL) environments that train AI agents to do real work across financial services verticals and adjacent domains.

Role Description

Halluminate is hiring part-time Data Analytics Subject Matter Experts (SMEs).
Frontier AI models can already build a clean budget model, run a standard variance analysis, and reconcile a simple ledger. We need experts who can push them further. In this role you'll design work that would challenge a strong senior analyst or controller, with multi-step reasoning, messy inputs, and the correct judgment calls where the right answer isn't obvious, then use it to expose where today's best AI models still fail. Your work feeds directly into the training data and frontier evaluations that leading AI labs use to measure and improve their models.
Your day-to-day in this role is RL environment task development and writing (i.e., creating the complex problem and solution that the AI agents must attempt to solve), not data labeling AI outputs based on your preferences or something less challenging.

Responsibilities

Shape the future of knowledge work by identifying which financial workflows matter most and where today's AI models fall short, drawing on your real experience
Build training materials for AI systems, including KPI dashboards, cohort analyses, SQL-based reports and A/B test readouts, and other real-world deliverables
Create challenging tasks that expose weaknesses in state-of-the-art AI models on financial services work
Contribute to frontier evaluations that measure how leading AI models perform on real finance workflows
Work directly with research and engineering teams at frontier labs to evaluate model outputs and turn findings into better training data
Revise tasks quickly based on feedback from reviewers and model results, often across multiple rounds

What we're looking for

2-5+ years of experience working in data analytics (business intelligence, analytics consulting, data science, product analytics, etc.)
Exceptional command of core workflows in Excel, PowerPoint, and other professional software programs (modeling, valuation, deal materials, memos)
Curiosity about machine learning, AI, data, and engineering concepts. No technical background required.
Comfort with direct, frequent feedback and the ability to turn it around quickly without losing quality
Sharp attention to detail and the judgment to spot exactly where an output would fail a senior review
Strong organization and full ownership of deadlines

Location

Fully Remote

Time Commitment

Minimum of 20 hours per week
You choose when to work

Compensation

Training milestone payments between $500-$4000
Implied hourly rate: $100/hour - $200/hour
Bonuses paid out for above average performance or stellar contributors

If interested please apply here: https://www.halluminate.ai/experts

Why work with Halluminate

Halluminate builds the highest quality, most complex training environments and benchmarks that leading AI labs rely on to push their most capable models forward. Our expert researchers lead that work. They design the problems, set the standards models are measured against, and uncover where frontier AI still falls short. Where other competitors may focus on data labeling / annotation, our experts are challenged to identify weak points in frontier labs models to accelerate AI capabilities in finance.
Market leading compensation. Our experts earn among the highest rates in the industry, with median earnings of $3,800 in September and our top 25% averaging over $30,000 that month.
Consistent Demand for Work. Halluminate experts get a steady stream of new projects, not stop-start bursts. You choose how much to take on, based on your schedule and earning goals.
Fully remote, you set your schedule. All work on the platform is completed remotely. We support work from outside the US: if you're traveling abroad temporarily, flag it to your Team Lead (note that work is not permitted from certain countries), and if you'll be abroad for an extended period, we can set your start date for when you return. Experts can work when they want and where they want as long as they hit their 20 hours per week minimum. There are no meetings, Zoom calls, or Slack huddles. All feedback from reviewers is left on our internal platform
Build the environments frontier models learn from. You design RL tasks grounded in real data rooms, define the expert-quality answers models are rewarded against, and find the failure modes that show where today's models fall short of professional judgment. Your work feeds directly into how leading AI labs train and evaluate their models.
Push the frontier of what AI can do. Our experts have contributed to industry benchmarks like Westworld Finance Diligence Bench, which tests AI agents on a complete acquisition due-diligence process.
A path into AI research. Top contributors have moved into team lead and full-time research roles at Halluminate.
Join an elite network. We work with a select group of professionals that are capable of building these AI training environments. You will be among a prestigious cohort with dedicated support in advancing the future of knowledge work.

You want your work to support the people who keep the food supply safe. If that sounds like you, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today!

Leader in food safety solutions for both contract sanitation and chemistry in the food processing industry.
Over 10,000 dedicated team members across North America.
Corporate headquarters in Atlanta, GA with team members working in over 250 plants throughout North America.
Over 50+ years of experience in creating long-lasting partnerships.

We protect the food supply by eliminating risks so families everywhere can eat without fear.

Protect What Matters: We are in service of safety at every step, ensuring the health of everyone is central to all we do – from plant team members to consumers.

Win as a Team: We believe in the power of collaboration, uniting our diverse strengths while working hand-in-hand with our team members and customers to unlock potential and achieve stronger results together.

Special Projects : Contribute to experimental or exploratory initiatives — new metrics, predictive models, or AI tools — as assigned by leadership.

Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Analytics, Statistics, Data Science, or a related field.
Proficiency in HRIS platforms and reporting/BI tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, Excel, SQL).
Demonstrated comfort using AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot) to support analysis, automate workflows, or accelerate reporting — and the judgment to know when to trust, verify, or override them.
Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret complex, sometimes messy data sets and translate findings into actionable insights.
A builder's mindset: you'd rather design a repeatable workflow than repeat manual work.
Genuine curiosity — you dig into anomalies instead of smoothing them over — paired with the creativity to present insights in ways that land with non-technical audiences.
Excellent communication and presentation skills to convey insights effectively to HR, Safety, and Compliance leadership.
Knowledge of HR metrics, workforce analytics, and compliance reporting.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and work collaboratively across cross-functional teams.
High attention to detail and an unwavering commitment to data accuracy.

Hands-on experience designing AI-assisted or automated reporting workflows (e.g., using Claude, Python, or low-code automation tools) in an HR or People Analytics context.
3 or more years of related experience.
Experience with predictive analytics and HR data modeling.
Familiarity with machine learning concepts and emerging HR technology trends.

Certification in HR analytics, data visualization, or AI/prompt engineering tools is a plus.

jobs.title: Senior Product Integration Engineer (CAD)
jobs.description:
About Mainspring
Mainspring Energy manufactures and delivers fuel-flexible, low-emissions local power solutions that rapidly add new capacity and deliver reliable, affordable, and sustainable electric power. The company began commercial shipments of its Mainspring Linear Generators in 2020 and today has hundreds of megawatts in advanced development and field operations for leading Fortune 500 companies, data centers, and utilities. Mainspring also partners with global energy leaders including AEP, NextEra Energy Resources, Schneider Electric, and more.

The core values that ground our work, guide our decisions, and connect us together:

Pragmatic Optimism

Excellence without Ego

Proactive Collaboration

Job Overview

Mainspring is seeking a Senior Product Integration Engineer (CAD) to own and maintain the integrated CAD definition of the Linear Generator as designs evolve. Design Engineers will continue to own the technical design and subsystem CAD; this role will make sure those designs are incorporated into authoritative POR and future-state reference assemblies and work together correctly in the context of the complete product.

This role combines product-definition ownership with hands-on whole-product CAD integration. The ideal candidate is exceptionally strong in 3D CAD, understands how complex mechanical systems fit together, and enjoys resolving packaging, interface, and configuration problems across multiple engineering teams. This role will be a key user of CATIA for full-product assemblies that exceed the practical limits of SolidWorks.

Core Responsibilities

• Build, maintain, and continuously improve authoritative POR and future-state reference assemblies for the Linear Generator

• Integrate subsystem CAD from multiple Design Engineering teams into full-product CATIA assemblies and keep those assemblies current as engineering changes progress

• Maintain clean full-product CAD structure, references, interfaces, metadata, and configuration logic across major assemblies

• Perform packaging studies, interference checks, clearance reviews, routing studies, service-access checks, and assembly-access evaluations

• Identify conflicting space claims and work with Design Engineers to negotiate interfaces and converge on practical whole-product solutions

• Create and maintain reference geometry, interface geometry, envelopes, simplified models, and other integration artifacts needed to support cross-team design work

• Support design reviews with clear visualizations of clashes, interfaces, access constraints, and product-level integration risks

• Identify and resolve inconsistencies among integrated CAD, drawings, EBOM structure, and the intended product configuration before release

• Support Product Release and Configuration Management by providing a clear, traceable digital definition of the product state being released

• Help establish scalable methods and standards for CATIA, large-assembly performance, imported geometry, simplification, reference assemblies, and cross-CAD workflows

Qualifications

• BS in Mechanical Engineering, Product Design, or a related technical field, or equivalent relevant experience

• 5+ years of experience in mechanical CAD, product design, packaging, product integration, or complex equipment design

• Advanced proficiency with CATIA, NX, Creo, SolidWorks, or another advanced 3D CAD platform; strong CATIA experience is highly preferred

• Demonstrated experience building and maintaining large, complex, multi-subsystem assemblies with disciplined reference and configuration practices

• Strong mechanical intuition and ability to identify packaging, clearance, routing, serviceability, assembly, and interface issues from 3D CAD

Company Description

Halluminate is an applied AI and data company working with frontier labs to train financial services and knowledge work superintelligence. We build high-quality computer-use and tool-use reinforcement learning (RL) environments that train AI agents to do real work across financial services verticals and adjacent domains.

Role Description

Halluminate is hiring part-time Product Management Subject Matter Experts (SMEs).
Frontier AI models can already build a clean budget model, run a standard variance analysis, and reconcile a simple ledger. We need experts who can push them further. In this role you'll design work that would challenge a strong senior analyst or controller, with multi-step reasoning, messy inputs, and the correct judgment calls where the right answer isn't obvious, then use it to expose where today's best AI models still fail. Your work feeds directly into the training data and frontier evaluations that leading AI labs use to measure and improve their models.

Your day-to-day in this role is RL environment task development and writing (i.e., creating the complex problem and solution that the AI agents must attempt to solve), not data labeling AI outputs based on your preferences or something less challenging.

Responsibilities

Shape the future of knowledge work by identifying which financial workflows matter most and where today's AI models fall short, drawing on your real experience
Build training materials for AI systems, including product requirements documents, feature prioritization analyses, go-to-market plans and product roadmaps, and other real-world deliverables
Create challenging tasks that expose weaknesses in state-of-the-art AI models on financial services work
Contribute to frontier evaluations that measure how leading AI models perform on real finance workflows
Work directly with research and engineering teams at frontier labs to evaluate model outputs and turn findings into better training data
Revise tasks quickly based on feedback from reviewers and model results, often across multiple rounds

What we're looking for

2-5+ years of experience working in product management (B2B or B2C software, fintech, platform or AI products, etc.)
Exceptional command of core workflows in Excel, PowerPoint, and other professional software programs (modeling, valuation, deal materials, memos)
Curiosity about machine learning, AI, data, and engineering concepts. No technical background required.
Comfort with direct, frequent feedback and the ability to turn it around quickly without losing quality
Sharp attention to detail and the judgment to spot exactly where an output would fail a senior review
Strong organization and full ownership of deadlines

Location

Fully Remote

Time Commitment

Minimum of 20 hours per week
You choose when to work

Compensation

Training milestone payments between $500-$4000
Implied hourly rate: $100/hour - $200/hour
Bonuses paid out for above average performance or stellar contributors

If interested please apply here: https://www.halluminate.ai/experts

Why work with Halluminate

Halluminate builds the highest quality, most complex training environments and benchmarks that leading AI labs rely on to push their most capable models forward. Our expert researchers lead that work. They design the problems, set the standards models are measured against, and uncover where frontier AI still falls short. Where other competitors may focus on data labeling / annotation, our experts are challenged to identify weak points in frontier labs models to accelerate AI capabilities in finance.
Market leading compensation. Our experts earn among the highest rates in the industry, with median earnings of $3,800 in September and our top 25% averaging over $30,000 that month.
Consistent Demand for Work. Halluminate experts get a steady stream of new projects, not stop-start bursts. You choose how much to take on, based on your schedule and earning goals.
Fully remote, you set your schedule. All work on the platform is completed remotely. We support work from outside the US: if you're traveling abroad temporarily, flag it to your Team Lead (note that work is not permitted from certain countries), and if you'll be abroad for an extended period, we can set your start date for when you return. Experts can work when they want and where they want as long as they hit their 20 hours per week minimum. There are no meetings, Zoom calls, or Slack huddles. All feedback from reviewers is left on our internal platform
Build the environments frontier models learn from. You design RL tasks grounded in real data rooms, define the expert-quality answers models are rewarded against, and find the failure modes that show where today's models fall short of professional judgment. Your work feeds directly into how leading AI labs train and evaluate their models.
Push the frontier of what AI can do. Our experts have contributed to industry benchmarks like Westworld Finance Diligence Bench, which tests AI agents on a complete acquisition due-diligence process.
A path into AI research. Top contributors have moved into team lead and full-time research roles at Halluminate.
Join an elite network. We work with a select group of professionals that are capable of building these AI training environments. You will be among a prestigious cohort with dedicated support in advancing the future of knowledge work.

Our hiring process

Four steps, each a preview of the actual work. You'll know quickly if it's a fit, and so will we.
Resume Review. We're looking for real depth in most knowledge work domains so please apply. We may have a project that fits your background now or in the near future.

Screening Call (30 minutes). Dive into your experience working in your field and with AI.

This role combines product-definition ownership with hands-on whole-product CAD integration. • Help establish scalable methods and standards for CATIA, large-assembly performance, imported geometry, simplification, reference assemblies, and cross-CAD workflows

Under general supervision, the Lab Assistant 3 provides skilled technical and operational support for research in the Doudna laboratory.
